class.name: OpenXRMetaSpatialEntityGroupSharingExtension
class.description: Wraps the [code]XR_META_spatial_entity_sharing[/code] and [code]XR_META_spatial_entity_group_sharing[/code] extensions, which share spatial entities with a group UUID chosen by the application instead of with Meta platform users. See [method OpenXRFbSpatialEntity.share_with_group] and [method OpenXRFbSpatialEntityQuery.query_by_group]. Enabled together with the [code]xr/openxr/extensions/meta/anchor_sharing[/code] project setting.

method.name: is_group_sharing_supported
method.description: Checks if both extensions are enabled.
